title: fix(metadata-core)!: a package ahead of the runtime is told to upgrade, not to run migrate meta
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5mffbTLuxZU5VwREBF7frY)_

Fixes #26480

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：安装一个协议主版本比运行时新的包（如在 18 上装 `^19`）时，`OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE` 拒绝不再建议 `migrate meta --from 19`，改为提示升级运行时或安装适配本主版本的包；`details` 里不再带 `migrateCommand`。
- **为什么改**：`migrate meta` 只能把旧主版本的元数据往前迁，对“包比运行时新”的情况是死路，运维会被误导。
- **风险与回滚**：低，但按规则记为对外类型收窄（BREAKING）：`ProtocolIncompatibleDiagnostic.migrateCommand` 从必有变为可选，仓外若有 TypeScript 代码直接取用它会在编译时报错。拒绝的 code 与 422 状态不变，旧主版本（如 `^17`）的提示完全不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.ts`（`checkProtocolCompat` 里 `ahead` 分支）；`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-install-protocol-incompatible.test.ts`（HTTP 门的新用例）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core exec vitest run src/protocol-handshake.test.ts`，预期 37/37 通过，其中 `[#26480]` 四条。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`checkProtocolCompat` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`) now compares the declared floor major (`declaredFloorMajor`) with the runtime's protocol major before it writes the prescription:

- **Floor major above the runtime's** (the package is ahead of the runtime): the diagnostic carries no `migrateCommand`, and the message ends `The package is built for a newer protocol than this runtime implements. Upgrade the runtime to protocol 19, or install a build of 'ID' for protocol 18`.
- **Floor major at or below the runtime's, or not determinable**: unchanged, `Run: objectstack migrate meta --from N` and `migrateCommand` as before.

`protocolIncompatibleAnswer` leaves `migrateCommand` out of `details` when the diagnostic has none (never `undefined`), so both HTTP doors, `POST /api/v1/packages` and `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`, answer four members for the ahead case. `ProtocolIncompatibleDiagnostic.migrateCommand` becomes optional in the exported type. The refusal's code and status (422 `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE`) do not change. Two comments that said the diagnostic always names `migrate meta` (`runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`, the rehydrate line in `cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`) now name both remedies. Changeset: `@objectstack/metadata-core` patch, with the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (runtime-interface-only packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.ts#ProtocolIncompatibleDiagnostic)`.

**BREAKING** public-surface narrowing, shipped as `patch` because it is not a metadata-protocol change: `ProtocolIncompatibleDiagnostic` is exported from `@objectstack/metadata-core`'s entry (`export * from './protocol-handshake.js'`), and its `migrateCommand` member goes from `string` to optional. A guaranteed output member that can now be absent narrows what the package exposes. pm-dispatch `execution-duties.md`: "收窄已发布接受集的卡是 `Clause-②: no`，不移车道；入队前欠一次契约复审档复核。" So the declaration is `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, and the PR owes a contract-review pass before it is queued.

No FROM → TO line, on purpose. AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3 asks for one when a change is "removing or renaming anything an author can write (a spec key, an export, a config field)"; this change removes and renames nothing, it makes one output member optional. The disposition it takes, `runtime-interface-only`, "ALSO inherits the `no-migration-prescription` refusal" (`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` header), so a rewrite prescription in the changeset would refuse the category. What a reader does instead is stated in prose: treat an absent `migrateCommand` as "no command applies; read `message`"; a TypeScript reader that dereferences it is told by its compiler.

## Why

The card's reproduction: on a protocol-18 runtime, `POST /api/v1/packages` with `engines.protocol: '^19'` answered `details.migrateCommand = objectstack migrate meta --from 19` and "Run: objectstack migrate meta --from 19". Migration only moves metadata forward from an older major, so the operator was sent to a command that cannot apply. Ruling: triage 6434187705.

## Tests

Red first on `main` (`00874b9e09`), then green on the fix:

| Suite | On `main` | On the fix |
|---|---|---|
| `metadata-core` `protocol-handshake.test.ts` | 3 failed, 34 passed | 37/37 |
| `runtime` `packages-install-protocol-incompatible.test.ts` (both door arms) | 2 failed, 6 passed | 8/8 |
| `cloud-connection` `marketplace-install-local-protocol-handshake.test.ts` (install door and rehydrate log line) | 2 failed, 11 passed | 13/13 |

- The new `[#26480]` blocks assert the ADR-0112 envelope (`code` + `status` 422), `details` without `migrateCommand`, no `migrate meta` in the message, and the runtime upgrade named. The `^17`-style control (`^10` on an 11 runtime in the unit suite, and every existing older-major test) keeps `--from N`.
- Ablation (committed fix, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): `const ahead = targetMajor !== null && targetMajor > runtimeMajor;` replaced by `const ahead = false;` turns the 3 unit tests red (34 still pass, the control included); restored from the HEAD blob `de811bf3863`, `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards.

Whole packages at `43b9bd0d9`: `metadata-core` test 827/827 + typecheck exit 0; `runtime` 8371 passed, 19 skipped + typecheck exit 0; `cloud-connection` 747/747 + typecheck exit 0. `eslint --no-inline-config` on the six touched `.ts` files: exit 0.

After merging `origin/main` (`d2ca7079b`), the three targeted suites again at `a08584332`: 37/37, 8/8, 13/13.

**Dogfood battery** (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm): `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure built, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock at `17bb14466`: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 300 passed, 3 skipped (303); Tests 2494 passed, 18 skipped (2512); no failures. The final head `a08584332` differs from `17bb14466` only in the changeset's `Clause-②` line (`git diff --stat`: 1 file, 1 line).

## Acceptance notes

- **Who reads `details.migrateCommand`.** No in-repo code outside tests reads it. The console's not-loaded marker reads only `code` and `requiredRange`; `os package install` prints the server's `error.message`; the artifact boot refusal (`runtime/src/artifact-reference.ts`) and the `service-package` rehydrate log embed `diagnostic.message`; the `cloud-connection` rehydrate line embeds the message and already says "install a version of the package built for protocol N". The CLI's `checkProtocolVersionGap` already stays silent when the declared major is at or above the installed one. None hard-codes the old text.
- **Documented field.** The spec error-code ledger comment for `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE` (`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`) lists `migrateCommand` among the `error.details` members. That stays true for older majors and is now incomplete for the ahead case; it is a comment under `packages/spec`, outside this lane, so it is left as is.
- **Same-class edge not changed here.** A range whose floor major equals the runtime's but still refuses it keeps `--from N`: on an 18 runtime, `'>18'` (which means 19 and up, so the package is ahead) and `'<18'` both answer `objectstack migrate meta --from 18`. Measured on the built `dist/` of this branch. The ruling covers a floor ABOVE the runtime's only, so it is reported to the seat rather than fixed here.

The changeset families re-run on the final head `a08584332`: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exit 0 ("1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition", `runtime-interface-only` verified on `ProtocolIncompatibleDiagnostic`); `check-changeset-no-major` with this body as the event exit 0 (LEVEL AXIS: `no (narrowing)`, `none`, `patch`); `check-empty-changeset` exit 0.
